summary: Iteration 7 (frontend-only retest): The single-line fix at /app/frontend/app/profile/[id].tsx load() (line 64: `const flat = data?.profile ? { user_id: data.user_id, ...data.profile } : data; setProfile(flat)`) RESOLVES the empty profile detail bug from iteration 6. Back button also works. Regression: Discover swipe interactions untouched (view profile pill navigated without triggering a swipe). Only observation remaining is the pre-existing 'shadow*' style props deprecation warning from react-native-web (carried over from iter 4-6, non-blocking).
